decisions.reason: An illuminated candle arch builds directly on the firm's core Erzgebirge-style woodcraft knowledge, and the sound feature is a small extension it can absorb and refine.
A one-tier Christmas pyramid is central to the firm's established expertise, so it can read market feedback well and keep improving the product.
The Dresden-themed pyramid uses proven pyramid know-how with a regional motif that suits the firm's tourist and collector market.
The electronic music box sits further from the firm's wood knowledge, but its interchangeable-disc system is a platform the firm has kept extending, which suggests it has learned to manage it.
This licensed story platform depends on outside content and electronics the firm does not hold itself, so it is more exposed to being retired once the edition runs its course.
The Christmas-themed platform fits the firm's seasonal Christmas assortment and the existing music box system, which makes it a low-effort complementary product to keep.
